newsitem.title: GREECE: COMMERCIAL BANK OFFERS LOANS FOR OTE SUBSCRIPTION.
newsitem.headline: COMMERCIAL BANK OFFERS LOANS FOR OTE SUBSCRIPTION.

text.p: Commercial Bank said on Monday all of its branches will be offering personal loans of up to 1.0 million drachmas for investors who wish to subscribe to OTE telecom's public offering during June 11-13.
It said procedures for the loan were "simple and fast" provided applicants met its criteria.
Moreover, Commercial Bank will waive the annual fee on its Visa credit card for new applicants who may use it for a cash advance to subscribe for OTE shares.
"All credit card holders -- old and new -- may make use of a special cash advance facility up to 300,000 drachmas," it said.

Subscriptions for OTE's public offering will take place during June 11-13. An indicative price range for the shares will be announced late on June 10. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
